method: Each scenario applies a proportional reduction to the historical concentrations and recomputes the CPCB sub-indices, the AQI, the AQI bucket and every cohort HAI value and band from first principles. The baseline is produced by the same code path with a zero reduction, so both sides of every comparison are computed identically.
what_this_is_not: The reduction is an input supplied by the user, not a prediction. The simulator states what the advisory burden would be at a given concentration; it does not claim that any particular intervention would achieve that concentration. Atmospheric chemistry is not simulated: each pollutant is reduced independently, so ozone-led scenarios in particular should be read with caution, because reducing nitrogen oxides can raise local ozone under some urban conditions.
advisory_day_definition: One advisory-day is one cohort, in one city, on one day, moved out of a restrictive HAI band. Summing across the seven cohorts gives the total advisory-day burden averted.

scenarios.name: PM2.5 reduced by 10%
scenarios.context: A modest fine-particulate reduction, of the order achievable by fuel-quality and fleet measures over a few years.

scenarios.name: PM2.5 reduced by 20%
scenarios.context: The scale of reduction targeted by the National Clean Air Programme for participating cities.

scenarios.name: PM2.5 and PM10 reduced by 20%
scenarios.context: Combined combustion and dust control, addressing both particulate fractions together.

scenarios.name: PM2.5 and PM10 reduced by 30%
scenarios.context: An ambitious particulate programme sustained over a decade.

scenarios.name: NO2 reduced by 30%
scenarios.context: Traffic demand management and tightened in-use vehicle emission testing.

scenarios.name: All pollutants reduced by 20%
scenarios.context: A broad economy-wide reduction, comparable in breadth to the 2020 lockdown though far smaller in depth.

scenarios.name: All pollutants reduced by 40%
scenarios.context: Approximately the depth of reduction observed during the 2020 national lockdown, applied to the whole record.

headline_scenario.name: PM2.5 and PM10 reduced by 20%
headline_scenario.context: Combined combustion and dust control, addressing both particulate fractions together.

lockdown_anchor.use: The lockdown is the only episode in this record that delivered an abrupt, broad emission reduction, so it is the closest available empirical check on a whole-economy scenario. The simulator's 'all pollutants reduced by 40%' case is the nearest comparator.
